author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Since you're T9, kill Ithra, the water god boss. Ithra's Blade is what you're looking for. Or, spam Apollyon, the T9 kingdom raid. He has a great weapon and  drops a lot of Ward gear which can really help. In general, if you can, join a kingdom and chip away at every single Kingdom raid as often as you can. If your kingdom isn't killing those ~daily, I'd try joining another one. If you're a really casual player and can't keep up with that, I'd definitely suggest you start doing Boss Dungeons as often as you can for the Ithra's chance.

When you have enough levels (215?), try going Charmer and use Warrior's Pavane. Otherwise I'd  consider playing Bard and using Warrior's Dance. It's good damage, if your attack is high enough.
